# bloxone_dns_auth_nsg (Resource)

Manages an Authoritative DNS Server Group for authoritative zones.

## Unified Nameservers

An authoritative DNS Server Group assigns its nameservers using one of two models. Which model a group uses depends on whether the **Unified Nameservers** feature is enabled for the account, and is reported by the read-only `version` attribute:

| `version` | Unified Nameservers | Nameserver assignment model |
| --------- | ------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `v1`      | Disabled            | Original DNS Server Group (NSG) model |
| `v2`      | Enabled             | Unified Nameservers model |

An account can contain both `v1` and `v2` DNS Server Groups, so the applicable model is a per-group question rather than an account-wide one. Read a group's `version` attribute — for example through the `bloxone_dns_auth_nsg` data source — before changing how it assigns nameservers.

### Attribute availability

The two models accept mutually exclusive sets of attributes:

| Attribute | `v1` — Unified Nameservers disabled | `v2` — Unified Nameservers enabled |
| --------- | ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `external_primaries`   | Configurable   | Not configurable |
| `external_secondaries` | Configurable   | Not configurable |
| `internal_secondaries` | Configurable   | Not configurable |
| `grid_primaries`       | Configurable   | Not configurable |
| `grid_secondaries`     | Configurable   | Not configurable |
| `nsgs`                 | Configurable   | Not configurable |
| `nameservers`          | Not configurable | Configurable |

Under the `v1` model a group separates its servers by role across `external_primaries`, `external_secondaries`, `internal_secondaries`, `grid_primaries` and `grid_secondaries`. Under the `v2` model a single `nameservers` list replaces all of them, and each entry carries its own `role` of `primary` or `secondary`.

`nameservers` conflicts with every `v1` attribute in the table, so a plan that mixes the two models is rejected before any API call is made.

### Restrictions on DNS Server Group assignment

Under Unified Nameservers the following DNS Server Group configurations are deprecated and are rejected:

- **Nested DNS Server Groups** — a DNS Server Group cannot be nested inside an authoritative DNS Server Group. This is why `nsgs` belongs to the `v1` model only.
- **Dual-role DNS Server Groups** — the same DNS Server Group cannot be assigned to both a primary zone and a secondary zone.
- **Multiple DNS Server Groups on an authoritative zone** — only one DNS Server Group may be assigned to an authoritative zone. A `v2` zone references it through the single-valued `nsg` attribute of `bloxone_dns_auth_zone`.
- **DNS Server Groups combined with internal secondaries** — a DNS Server Group and internal secondaries cannot coexist on an authoritative zone.

Review existing configurations for these patterns and update them before they are enforced.

## Example Usage

The following example configures a DNS Server Group under the original model, where Unified Nameservers is disabled (`version` is `v1`):

```terraform
resource "bloxone_dns_auth_nsg" "example" {
  name = "example_dns_auth_nsg"

  # Other Optional fields
  comment = "An example auth nsg"
  external_primaries = [
    {
      address = "12.10.2.1",
      fqdn    = "ext.primary.com."
      type    = "primary"
    },
  ]
  external_secondaries = [
    {
      address = "12.10.2.2",
      fqdn    = "ext.primary.com."
    }
  ]
  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}
```

## Example Usage With Unified Nameservers

The following example configures a DNS Server Group under the Unified Nameservers model (`version` is `v2`), where every server is declared in the `nameservers` list:

```terraform
# DNS Server Groups that use the Unified Nameservers model (version = "v2")
# assign every nameserver through the single "nameservers" list.
resource "bloxone_dns_auth_nsg" "example_unified" {
  name = "example_unified_dns_auth_nsg"

  nameservers = [
    {
      role    = "primary"
      address = "12.10.2.1"
      fqdn    = "ns1.primary.com."
    },
    {
      role         = "secondary"
      address      = "12.10.2.2"
      fqdn         = "ns2.secondary.com."
      stealth      = false
      tsig_enabled = false
    },
  ]

  # Other optional fields
  comment = "An example auth nsg using Unified Nameservers"
  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional. Comment for the object.
- `external_primaries` (Attributes List) Optional. DNS primaries external to Universal DDI. Order is not significant. Can be configured only when Unified Nameservers is disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_primaries))
- `external_secondaries` (Attributes List) DNS secondaries external to Universal DDI. Order is not significant. Can be configured only when Unified Nameservers is disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_secondaries))
- `grid_primaries` (Attributes List) Optional. The list of the NIOS Grid Primaries assigned to an AuthNSG, only applicable for the NIOS. Can be configured only when Unified Nameservers is disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grid_primaries))
- `grid_secondaries` (Attributes List) Optional. The list of the NIOS Grid Secondaries assigned to an AuthNSG, only applicable for the NIOS. Can be configured only when Unified Nameservers is disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grid_secondaries))
- `internal_secondaries` (Attributes List) Optional. Universal DDI hosts acting as internal secondaries. Order is not significant. Can be configured only when Unified Nameservers is disabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--internal_secondaries))
- `nameservers` (Attributes List) Optional. A list of DNS Nameservers of various roles. Can be configured only when Unified Nameservers is enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nameservers))
- `nsgs` (List of String) List of nameserver group identifiers nested within this DNS Server Group. Can be configured only when Unified Nameservers is disabled.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tagging specifics.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) Tagging specifics includes default tags.
- `version` (String) Read Only. Version indicates the version of the Authoritative DNS Server Group in context of DNS NSGs and nameservers that are used. Possible values:
- _v1_: The Authoritative DNS Server Group uses original NSG model
- _v2_: The Authoritative DNS Server Group uses new "Unified Nameservers" model

### Nested Schema for `external_primaries`

Optional:

### Nested Schema for `nameservers`

Required:

Optional:

- `address` (String) Optional. Required only if _origin_ is _external_. IP Address of the nameserver.
- `fqdn` (String) Optional. Required only if _origin_ is _external_. FQDN of the nameserver.

- `stealth` (Boolean) If enabled, the NS record and glue record will NOT be automatically generated according to secondaries nameserver assignment.  Default: _false_

- `tsig_key` (Attributes) Object representing TSIG key synced from Keys Service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nameservers--tsig_key))

Read-Only:

- `origin` (String) Origin of the Name Server.
- `protocol_fqdn` (String) FQDN of the nameserver in punycode.
